_comment: Rewrites French lessons 2-9 into their assigned archetypes (F,B,C,E,D,A,F,C) from scripts/content/lessons/FRENCH-VARIETY.md, adding one transform exercise to each archetype B-F lesson (L7/fr-plural is archetype A and gains none). Every existing exercise is carried over verbatim. The archetype tables name seven non-meet slots but each lesson also has a `review` exercise; `review` is kept and placed immediately before the dictation (its position in archetype A), so B-F lessons hold nine exercises, not eight. Applied centrally by scripts/content/differentiate-first-words.py; not run here.

exercises.prompt: Which French word means “I study”?
